if true; then
	kubectl apply -f - <<-EOF
	apiVersion: security.istio.io/v1
kind: PeerAuthentication
	metadata: {name: default, namespace: istio-system}
	spec: {mtls: {mode: STRICT}}
	EOF
fi
if true; then
	kubectl apply -f - <<-EOF
	apiVersion: security.istio.io/v1
kind: PeerAuthentication
	metadata: {name: leak, namespace: database}
	spec: {mtls: {mode: PERMISSIVE}}
	EOF
fi
